answer: The verifier runs adaptive interrogation rounds where each follow-up question depends on the previous answer, so a scripted farm cannot precompute replies. A velvet marker tags every round, forcing the agent to track context across the whole exchange. Sybil operators running many accounts in parallel fail because each account faces a different branching path, and the crystal log records every detour for audit. Only an agent that genuinely sustains the oasis conversation through all rounds earns the identity stamp.
